note: Shared by the Rust (roamswitch-core agent_check.rs) and Swift (Shared/AgentCheck.swift) tests. vectors: tool + input + environment (feed, allowlist, cwd) -> verdict and reason keys. A name starting with limit- documents what the check does not see (the verdict is allow on purpose). dev_corpus: typical development commands, none may be asked or denied.

input.command:
echo start
curl http://169.254.169.254/
echo end

cat <<-'EOT' > note.md
	curl http://169.254.169.254/
	EOT
ls
gh pr create --title 'Fix' --body 'Remove .env from the repo' --repo example/repo

dev_corpus: git commit -m "Add destination check for agent hooks"
git commit -m "Update .env.example and docs, see https://example.com/docs"
awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
gh pr create --title "Fix" --body "Remove .env from the repo" --repo example/repo
